_about: Strict DINO -> VLM configuration: per-task cameras, crops and questions from development. No task-specific DINO bypass or release-only check. Historical hybrid settings remain in saved run.json files.
_selection: Every three-frame DINO alarm requires VLM verification. Explicit task-context questions cover tasks without a specific check; uncovered phases use the same context template. New context questions use the 0.5 default, with limited normal-alarm validation; existing calibrated checks retain their historical cutoffs. No DINO-only fallback.
